Name: Flash Fire
Effect: The first time this Pokémon is hit by a Fire-Type move, add 1 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of Fire-type Moves this Pokémon uses until the end of the scene. Fire-type moves do not deal damage to this Pokémon.
Description: This Pokémon is capable of consuming other fire sources and adding them to its own. Walking through embers, fire, lava and hell feel like a breeze to it.
